description: Skills for L1/L2/L3 SOC analyst operations

shared.name: incident-investigation
shared.description: Core incident investigation methodology — triage, scoping, evidence collection, timeline reconstruction, and documentation. Used by all tiers.

shared.name: teams-notification
shared.description: Send notifications to Microsoft Teams channels for incident updates, escalations, and shift communications.

bunk.name: phishing-response
bunk.description: Automated phishing response playbook — email header analysis, URL/attachment detonation, mailbox search-and-purge, user notification, IOC extraction.

bunk.name: compromised-account
bunk.description: Automated compromised account playbook — force password reset, revoke sessions, review sign-in logs, check MFA status, assess blast radius.

kima.name: sentinel-analytics-rules
kima.description: Create, tune, and validate Microsoft Sentinel analytics rules — scheduled queries, NRT rules, fusion rules, threshold calibration, entity mapping, false positive reduction.

kima.name: sentinel-enrichment-ip
kima.description: IP address enrichment — threat intelligence lookups, geo-location, ASN/ISP identification, reputation scoring, historical activity correlation, VPN/Tor/proxy detection.

kima.name: sentinel-enrichment-user
kima.description: User entity enrichment — Entra ID profile, group membership, recent sign-in activity, risk score, device registrations, privilege level, behavioral baseline comparison.

freamon.name: threat-hunting-foundations
freamon.description: Hypothesis-driven threat hunting — formulate hypotheses from threat intelligence, map to MITRE ATT&CK techniques, design hunt queries, document findings and detection gaps.

freamon.name: cross-workspace-queries
freamon.description: Cross-workspace and cross-resource KQL queries — workspace() and resource() functions, ADX proxy queries, multi-tenant hunting, performance optimization for large-scale joins.

freamon.name: ueba-patterns
freamon.description: User and Entity Behavior Analytics patterns — anomaly detection baselines, peer group analysis, impossible travel, unusual resource access, privilege escalation sequences.

freamon.name: defender-xdr-hunting
freamon.description: Microsoft Defender XDR advanced hunting — DeviceEvents, EmailEvents, IdentityLogonEvents, CloudAppEvents, cross-domain correlation, custom detection rules.

daniels.name: teams-notification
daniels.description: Send notifications to Microsoft Teams channels for incident updates, escalations, and shift communications.

daniels.name: ticket-create
daniels.description: Create and update tickets in the incident management system — severity classification, assignment, SLA tracking, stakeholder notification, status updates.
